subject: using reactive variables to set reactivePlot width

messages.author: 2935e7de556025cb
messages.subject: using reactive variables to set reactivePlot width
parts:
Hi,

I'm puzzling over how to set my plot width to match the number of variables I'm displaying.

Not really knowing what I was doing, here's how I coded it:

output$plot <-reactivePlot(function() {
  crop <- get(input$crop)
  crop <- crop[crop$Region==input$state,]
  par (cex.axis=0.6)
  plotmeans(as.formula(paste(input$trait,"~VarName")),data=crop,connect=FALSE)
  },
  width=length(levels(droplevels(traits[traits$state==input$state&traits$crop==input$crop,"trait"])))*40
)

However, I get this error: 

Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext() : 
  Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive function.)

Anyone have any ideas for a workaround?

Jared
